acceptedAnswer.text: An AI PR agency runs media strategy for AI companies: positioning, journalist outreach, embargo management, podcast placement and analyst briefings. It is for AI infrastructure companies, AI agent startups, foundation model labs and enterprise AI tools that need tier-1 credibility, not just content volume. A fractional operator like Shilika Jain delivers the same senior scope as a full agency for $5K–$12K/month, without the junior account-team layer.

mainEntity.name: How much does AI PR cost in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service AI PR agencies typically charge $15K–$45K per month because the retainer covers a multi-person team. A fractional senior operator handles the same strategic scope for $5K–$12K per month. A focused launch sprint, covering positioning, embargo and tier-1 outreach for a product launch or funding round, runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you place an AI company in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 tech and business: Forbes, TechCrunch, The Information, Wired, VentureBeat. AI-specific: AI Magazine, The Batch, Import AI. Crypto-adjacent AI: CoinDesk, Decrypt, Cointelegraph, The Block. Financial and mainstream: Benzinga, Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg. Coverage depends on a real news hook, a differentiated angle and timing that aligns with what editors are covering, not a spray-and-pray wire blast.
